title: Grateful Dead Live at Springfield Civic Center Arena on 1977-04-23
lineage: Master played back on Nakamichi Dragon > Grace Lunatec V3 (24/96)> Digital Audio Labs Card Deluxe soundcard> Adobe Audition > Downsample/Dither> flac encoding > FLAC
source: Recorded by Steve Hopkins Master Audience Cassette; Sony ECM-99a > Sony TC-152sd with dolby b encoding According to Steve "we set up just about center ice, as i recall, perhaps a little to the right so we were more lined up with the right stack.  if my memory serves me well, we taped the microphone to the top of a walking cane and hand-held that about 2 to 3 feet over our heads and above the crowd."

ai_review.summary: High‑energy show with a stellar setlist (Sugaree, Help‑Slip‑Franklin’s, GDTRFB) captured on a distant ECM‑99A audience mic that sounds good overall.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the explosive first and second sets – highlights include an amazing Sugaree, a tight Help > Slip > Franklin's sequence and a top‑notch performance of GDTRFB. The tape was recorded with a distant stereo ECM‑99A mic (about 60 ft out), delivering a clear if ambient sound that most reviewers find very listenable.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviews are strongly positive, with average user stars of 4.5; the show is praised for its setlist and performance while the recording is noted as good despite being a distant audience mic.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Recorded with an ECM‑99A stereo microphone positioned ~60 ft from the stage; clear enough for most listeners, no major drop‑outs or muddiness reported.

standout_songs: Help on the Way > Slipknot! > Franklin's Tower
show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows superbly – a strong first half (Sugaree, Cassidy, etc.) that could stand alone, followed by an even tighter second set highlighted by the short‑sweet Help‑Slip‑Franklin's and other classics.
